figs.name: rtd-resistance-to-temperature-lead-wire-error-diagram
figs.alt: two wire PT100 circuit showing 1.19 ohm lead resistance adding a 3.1 degree error
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how 50 m of 1.5 mm2 copper adds 1.19 ohm to a 2 wire RTD, reading 3.1 °C high on a PT100 but 0.31 °C on a PT1000.
figs.after_h2: Lead Wire Resistance Error: Why 2-Wire RTDs Give Wrong Readings
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Two wire RTD lead resistance error with 50 m of 1.5 mm2 copper cable</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lead Wire Error in a 2 Wire PT100</text>
<rect x="60" y="150" width="60" height="170" rx="8" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="3"/>
<polyline points="90,165 75,180 105,195 75,210 105,225 75,240 105,255 75,270 105,285 90,300" fill="none" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="90" y="140" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT100</text>
<text x="90" y="345" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rt</text>
<line x1="120" y1="165" x2="560" y2="165" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<rect x="270" y="153" width="70" height="24" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="340" y="143" font-size="18" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lead 1: 50 m × 0.0119 = 0.595 Ω</text>
<line x1="120" y1="305" x2="560" y2="305" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<rect x="270" y="293" width="70" height="24" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="340" y="343" font-size="18" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lead 2: 50 m × 0.0119 = 0.595 Ω</text>
<rect x="560" y="130" width="210" height="210" rx="10" fill="#eef6ff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="665.0" y="216.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transmitter</text>
<text x="665.0" y="241.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">measures</text>
<text x="665.0" y="266.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Rt + 1.19 Ω</text>
<text x="250" y="240" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field</text>
<text x="470" y="240" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">50 m cable</text>
<rect x="40" y="395" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="215.0" y="429.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT100 error</text>
<text x="215.0" y="453.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1.19 ÷ 0.385 = +3.1 °C high</text>
<rect x="410" y="395" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="429.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT1000 error</text>
<text x="585.0" y="453.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1.19 ÷ 3.851 = 0.31 °C</text>
</svg>

figs.name: rtd-resistance-to-temperature-formula-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for choosing the linear RTD formula or Callendar Van Dusen equation
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when to use the linear RTD formula and when to use the Callendar Van Dusen equation, with the 119.40 and 175 ohm worked examples.
figs.after_h2: The Callendar-Van Dusen Equation: Accurate Calculation for Wide Ranges
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to convert RTD resistance to temperature with linear or Callendar Van Dusen formula</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which RTD Formula Should You Use?</text>
<rect x="260" y="58" width="280" height="54" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="91.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Measured resistance Rt</text>
<line x1="400" y1="114" x2="400" y2="136" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,138.0 550.0,180 400,222.0 250.0,180" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="186.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor type?</text>
<rect x="20" y="150" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110.0" y="174.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT100</text>
<text x="110.0" y="198.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R0 = 100 Ω</text>
<line x1="250" y1="180" x2="202" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="600" y="150" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690.0" y="174.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PT1000</text>
<text x="690.0" y="198.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R0 = 1000 Ω</text>
<line x1="550" y1="180" x2="598" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="400" y1="224" x2="400" y2="250" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,252.0 590.0,300 400,348.0 210.0,300" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="295.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Between minus 50 °C</text>
<text x="400" y="318.15" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">and 150 °C?</text>
<polyline points="210,300 210,345" fill="none" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="180" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="590,300 590,345" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="625" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="30" y="348" width="360" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="385.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Linear formula</text>
<text x="210.0" y="409.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">T = (Rt − R0) ÷ (α × R0)</text>
<text x="210.0" y="433.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">α = 0.00385, error under 0.5 °C</text>
<rect x="410" y="348" width="360" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590.0" y="385.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Callendar Van Dusen</text>
<text x="590.0" y="409.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">R0(1 + AT + BT²) = Rt for T ≥ 0 °C</text>
<text x="590.0" y="433.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">A = 0.0039083, B = −0.0000005775</text>
<rect x="30" y="478" width="360" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210.0" y="522.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example: 119.40 Ω</text>
<text x="210.0" y="546.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">19.40 ÷ 0.385 = 50.39 °C</text>
<rect x="410" y="478" width="360" height="100" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590.0" y="522.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example: 175.00 Ω</text>
<text x="590.0" y="546.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CVD 197.7 °C, linear 194.8 °C</text>
</svg>
